urls.title: YouTube URLs
urls.description: Videos, playlists or channels, one per line. Channel links can be @handles (https://www.youtube.com/@TED), /channel/ IDs or old /c/ and /user/ links. Playlists must be public or unlisted.

apiKey.title: BulkTranscripts API key
apiKey.description: Needed for your own videos, playlists and channels. Sign in at https://bulktranscripts.co/app?tab=mcp and create a key in under a minute: new accounts get 30 free transcripts. A license key from a credit pack also works. Leave it empty to try the example video for free.

maxVideos.title: Max videos per channel or playlist
maxVideos.description: Newest videos first for channels. Each new transcript uses one BulkTranscripts credit; videos already in your library are free.

language.title: Preferred caption language
language.description: Language code such as en, es, de or pt. If a video has no captions in this language, its available captions are used.

includeSegments.title: Include timestamped segments
includeSegments.description: Adds a segments array (start time, duration, text) to every row. Leave off if you only need the text.
